:::{#def-commutative}
#### Commutative operation

An operation $\star$ on a set $S$ (@def-identity-element)
is **commutative**
[@wikipedia_commutative_property]
if $a \star b = b \star a$ for all $a, b \in S$:
the order of the two inputs does not matter.
Some sources call a commutative operation **symmetric**,
as in the theorem titles "Sums are symmetric" and "Products are symmetric".

:::
